{{Quote|A whole war going on around me, and here I am, stuck on an automated ship, playing nursemaid to farm animals...!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Ahsoka's Ark">{{TCWComicCite|6.36|Ahsoka's Ark}}</ref>}}
This '''unidentified ark''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] starship.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was used to carry [[Farm/Legends|farmed]] animals to recently [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] worlds.
